notes.title: Update to fix issue with Cash score carrying forward per playthrough
notes.notes: When players where going from round to round the cash score was coming with them and inflating too high. So I put an end to that chicanery.

notes.title: DROP 2 IS NOW LIVE - WIN A PLAYSTATION 5
notes.notes:
🛠️ Tooncop – Drop 2 Patch Notes
Version: Drop 2 Launch Build

🎉 New Content
🔥 DROP 2 IS LIVE!

notes.title: April Patch
notes.notes:
First patch for a while. Sorry guys, life got in the way of making hobby games. I've updated the enemies so fewer of them will be stuck in the ground. 

Also added some new parts to Neighborhood Dark....

notes.title: UPDATE 1
notes.notes:
Hi Guys. 

Just a quick note to say that the map Neighborhood Dark has been updated and is now the official Nightmare Mode of the game. 

I've also added a number of guns to the map, just find the houses with the lights on to find the guns. 

They are mostly SMGs in this update and I'll be adding more guns as time progresses. 

Another update is that we now have Russian localization on the Steam Page for those countries that speak the language. Big thanks to Berry for offering to help with that one. 

More updates are in the pipeline. 

Thank you all, happy shooting.

notes.title: Thanks to everyone that's checked my game out
notes.notes:
I just wanted to say a big thanks to everyone that's downloaded and played the game. I didn't think anyone actually would. Just wanted to let you all know that I'm working on updating the game as much as I can. I had some issues with a corrupt local version control depot but that's fixed now so the updates will be flowing. 

The next step for me is to add more guns to the game that you can find in the houses on Neighbourhood Dark, and I will be adding them to the houses in Neighbourhood as well. 

The construction yard will be kept as is for now but I may extend it later on. 

I know there's not a lot happening right now in the game but I do plan on adding more to it, including more cartoon characters and lots more new bosses. 

Thanks again for playing, I know it's not much but for me it's a massive achievement to even get this far. 

Cheers
Idene.
